description: This file contains Swagger API documentation schemas for the CodeValues API resource in the Apache Fineract project. It defines data transfer objects (DTOs) used for API requests and responses related to code values, including creation, retrieval, updating, and deletion of code value data.

classes.name: CodeValuesApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: A container for Swagger schema classes related to Code Values API operations in Fineract.

classes.name: CodeValuesApiResourceSwagger.GetCodeValuesDataResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response data when retrieving code values.

classes.name: CodeValuesApiResourceSwagger.PostCodeValuesDataRequest
classes.description: Schema for the request data to create new code values.

classes.name: CodeValuesApiResourceSwagger.PostCodeValueDataResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after creating a new code value.

classes.name: CodeValuesApiResourceSwagger.PutCodeValuesDataRequest
classes.description: Schema for the request data to update existing code values.

classes.name: CodeValuesApiResourceSwagger.PutCodeValueDataResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after updating a code value, including nested changes.

classes.name: CodeValuesApiResourceSwagger.DeleteCodeValueDataResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after deleting a code value.
